description: Web admin SEO dashboard + wiring. Adds the typed client (lib/seoAdmin.ts) and the new SEO dashboard page (AdminSeo.tsx) with real-data counters and the four required action buttons, wires it into the /admin router and ADMIN_TABS nav, extends types.ts with the new SEO fields + SeoConfig.defaultLang + dashboard types, mirrors the new feature flags into web/src/lib/features.ts, and adds a defaultLang select to the existing SEO sub-tab. Depends on FEAT-002's endpoints. Leaves `npm run build` in web passing with no change to existing storefront rendering.
steps: Create web/src/lib/seoAdmin.ts: a typed client mirroring web/src/lib/admin.ts style for every /admin/seo-auto/* endpoint (getDashboard, listSeoProducts, optimize, audit, getJob, listJobs, rollback, setOverride, resetAuto, getIntegrations, setIntegration) plus @tanstack/react-query hooks for the dashboard and job-status polling.

Create web/src/pages/admin/AdminSeo.tsx: the dashboard (design section 8). Sections of counters sourced ONLY from GET /dashboard (products optimized / needing attention / missing / duplicate metadata, categories optimized, valid/invalid canonicals, sitemap status, schema validation status, indexing problems, recent automatic changes from seo_audit_log, background-job status, connected integrations). PHASE-2 metrics (broken links, Core Web Vitals, organic performance/GSC) render an explicit 'not available yet' / 'connect GA4' / 'not connected' state — never placeholder numbers. Four buttons: Optimize All Eligible Products, Optimize Selected Products, Run Full Audit, Rollback Last Changes — each posts to its endpoint and polls the returned job. Bilingual Hindi/English copy matching the existing admin.
Edit web/src/App.tsx: add `<Route path="seo" element={<AdminSeo />} />` inside the `/admin` shell route, with the import for AdminSeo.
Edit web/src/pages/admin/AdminApp.tsx: add an ADMIN_TABS entry `{ path: 'seo', key: 'settings', icon: '🔍', label: 'SEO', title: '🔍 SEO Engine' }` (gated by the existing settings permission).

Edit web/src/types.ts: add the new product SEO fields (seo_slug, seo_score, seo_problems, seo_overrides) and category SEO fields, the SEO dashboard response types, and `defaultLang?: 'hi' | 'en'` on SeoConfig.

Edit web/src/lib/features.ts: add seoAuto + seoAutoGsc/seoAutoGa4/seoAutoGbp/seoAutoCrawler to FEATURE_KEYS and bilingual FEATURE_LABELS; any PHASE-2 call site reads the flag as `isFeatureOn(features, key, false)` while seoAuto uses the normal default. Add a comment noting the inverted convention.

Edit web/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.tsx: add a small defaultLang select (Hindi / English) to the existing SEO sub-tab form that posts through the existing saveSeo() to POST /seo (now that seoSchema + mergeSeoConfig carry defaultLang). ADD-only — do not restructure the existing form.
acceptance_criteria: Running `npm run build` in web (tsc -b && vite build) exits 0.
The SEO tab appears in the admin sidebar for users with the settings permission and routes to AdminSeo at /admin/seo.
AdminSeo renders real counters from the dashboard endpoint and shows explicit not-available/not-connected states for PHASE-2 metrics (no hardcoded placeholder numbers).
The four action buttons post to their endpoints and poll the returned job.
The SEO sub-tab exposes a working defaultLang (Hindi/English) select saved via the existing saveSeo().
No existing storefront page (Home/ProductDetails/Page) rendering is changed.
verification: Run `npm run build` in web — must exit 0 (both tsc -b and vite build pass).
findings:
FEAT-003 landed. VERIFICATION: `npm run build` in web exits 0 (generate-sitemap + tsc -b + vite build all pass; 715 modules transformed). The worktree had no node_modules, so `npm install` was run once in web/ before building (installs only; nothing committed — node_modules is gitignored).

NEW FILES: web/src/lib/seoAdmin.ts, web/src/pages/admin/AdminSeo.tsx. EDITED: web/src/App.tsx, web/src/pages/admin/AdminApp.tsx, web/src/types.ts, web/src/lib/features.ts, web/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.tsx.

seoAdmin.ts: typed client mirroring lib/admin.ts for every /admin/seo-auto/* endpoint — getDashboard, listSeoProducts, optimize, runAudit, getJob, listJobs, rollback, setOverride, resetAuto, getIntegrations, setIntegration — plus React-Query hooks: useSeoDashboard (15s refetch), useSeoJob (polls 1.5s while queued/running, stops on terminal via refetchInterval callback reading query.state.data), useOptimize/useRunAudit/useRollback (invalidate ['seo-dashboard']). Responses read the shared { success, ...payload } envelope straight off axios .data.

AdminSeo.tsx: dashboard sourced ONLY from GET /dashboard. Real-data counter cards: products {total, optimized, needingAttention, withProblems, missingMetadata}, categories {total, optimized, needingAttention}, duplicate {titles, descriptions, slugs}, attention threshold shown. PHASE-2 metrics (brokenLinks, coreWebVitals, organicPerformance) render an explicit dashed 'Not available yet'/'Not connected' card via PhaseTwoCard — NO placeholder numbers. Sections: integrations (status + message, never secrets), background jobs list, recent automatic changes from seo_audit_log. Four buttons: Optimize All Eligible (mode:'all'), Optimize Selected (mode:'selected' + productIds parsed from a comma/space input, with a 'load needs-attention' helper calling listSeoProducts), Run Full Audit (POST /audit), Rollback Last Changes (POST /rollback no jobId = last backup). Each optimize/audit sets activeJobId and the JobProgress bar polls via useSeoJob until terminal. Bilingual Hindi/English copy.

App.tsx: added `<Route path="seo" element={<AdminSeo />} />` inside the /admin shell + import. AdminApp.tsx: ADMIN_TABS entry { path:'seo', key:'settings', icon:'🔍', label:'SEO', title:'🔍 SEO Engine' } — gated by the existing settings permission (same key as Settings/Pages). types.ts: added product SEO fields (seo_slug, seo_score, seo_problems, seo_overrides), category SEO fields (seo_title/description/keywords/intro, og_image, seo_score, seo_problems, seo_overrides), defaultLang?:'hi'|'en' on SeoConfig, and the dashboard response types (SeoDashboard/SeoDashboardCounters/SeoJobView/SeoIntegrationStatus/SeoRecentChange/SeoProductRow/SeoProductsPage + SeoProductsFilter/SeoOptimizeMode/SeoUnavailable). features.ts: added seoAuto + seoAutoGsc/seoAutoGa4/seoAutoGbp/seoAutoCrawler to FEATURE_KEYS and bilingual FEATURE_LABELS, with a comment documenting the inverted convention (PHASE-2 keys read with def=false; seoAuto uses the normal default). AdminSettings.tsx SEO sub-tab: ADD-only defaultLang select (Hindi/English) wired to the existing seo state + saveSeo() to POST /seo (backend seoSchema + mergeSeoConfig already carry defaultLang per FEAT-001/002). No existing storefront rendering changed.
